name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(door_open) and Existence(target_picked_up) clauses correctly capture the two imperative commands, with no redundant or missing requirements, and the reward machine reflects the intended behavior.

texts: Door must be opened at least once
Target box must be picked up at least once
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, target_picked_up) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u3) -> 12
(u1, door_open, u3) -> 11
(u2, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
